summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Pump Fit Client Portal. All core features working perfectly including client registration, login, session scheduling, and portal navigation. Backend APIs 100% functional, frontend 98% success rate with only minor accessibility warnings.

design_issues.issue: Missing aria-describedby attributes causing accessibility warnings
design_issues.details: Console warnings: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'

passed_tests: Client login page access at /cliente route
Toggle between login and registration forms
Client registration creates user account and client profile
Sessions tab shows upcoming sessions and history
Progress tab shows measurements (empty state handled correctly)
Session scheduling complete flow (package → date → time → suit → save)
Available slots endpoint returns correct data (34 time slots)
Portal correctly hides/shows schedule button based on package availability
Session appears in upcoming sessions after creation
Statistics update correctly after session scheduling
Redirect protection for unauthenticated portal access
action_item_for_main_agent: Add aria-describedby attributes to Dialog components for better accessibility compliance. This is a minor enhancement to eliminate console warnings.
